product.notes: 167 g (Sub6) / 168 g (mmWave) per Samsung press specs. 4000 mAh typical, 3880 mAh rated. 6.2 in full rectangle (6.0 in with rounded corners), 2340x1080 Dynamic AMOLED 2X. Rear: 50 MP f/1.8 main (OIS), 10 MP f/2.4 3x telephoto (OIS), 12 MP f/2.2 ultrawide; front 12 MP f/2.2. Armor Aluminum frame, Gorilla Glass Victus 2 front and back. Coordinates: screen down, viewed from back; x=0 at left edge seen from back (the side-key side), y=0 at USB-C end, z=0 at front glass.

sources.title: SamMobile - Galaxy S24 teardown video shows how easy repair is

parts.name_en: Armor Aluminum frame / midframe (front housing body)

parts.notes: Base part. Samsung/iFixit sell 'screen and battery assembly' = frame + display + battery as one unit (s9). Container part: other parts sit inside its bbox. Rail height and midplate z are estimated.

desc.ko: 알루미늄 프레임과 중간판. 디스플레이를 앞에 붙이고, 나머지 부품을 뒤에서 차례로 얹어요.

parts.name_en: Display assembly (Gorilla Glass Victus 2 + Dynamic AMOLED 2X panel)
parts.shapeNote: flat rounded rect ~69.9x146.3 with a centred punch hole near the top edge and a flex tail folded behind the panel at the bottom
parts.notes: Separates from the frame toward the front after heating (s7). Panel thickness (1.3 mm) is estimated.

desc.ko: 6.2인치 디스플레이. 앞면 유리와 패널이 한 덩어리로 붙어 있어요.

parts.name_en: Display panel flex connector (left of daughterboard)

parts.notes: s5/s7 place it at the bottom-left, just left of the daughterboard; xy estimated.

parts.shapeNote: thin flat copper plate under the motherboard area
parts.notes: s14 confirms a VC about twice the S23's area but gives no outline; position under the SoC area and size are guesses. Not removed in any iFixit guide, so treated as part of the front housing.

parts.shapeNote: short pill-shaped key in the side rail
parts.notes: Keys are on the right side seen from the front, i.e. x=0 seen from the back. Not covered by any guide; y positions estimated.

parts.shapeNote: long pill-shaped rocker above the power key
parts.notes: Not covered by guides; position estimated.

parts.shapeNote: small rectangular linear motor
parts.notes: No S24-specific source gives its position. Not removed in s9, so it is assumed to stay in the front housing near the bottom. Treat position as a guess. Placed over the sub board, so it goes in after the sub board (estimated position).

parts.shapeNote: thin film under the battery with a blue pull tab exiting at the left edge (seen from back)

parts.shapeNote: rounded rect ~60x68x4.9 pouch cell, flex tail at top edge toward the motherboard

parts.shapeNote: wide rectangular PCB across the bottom, USB-C at its lower centre, SIM reader on the right

desc.ko: USB-C 포트와 SIM 리더가 있는 보조 보드. 케이블 두 가닥으로 메인보드와 이어져요.

parts.shapeNote: two screws at the ends of the bracket
long narrow flex routed along the left rail (route guessed)
parts.notes: s5 disconnects a '5G mmWave' connector on the motherboard bottom-left edge; s8 bends it up but no guide removes it. Its far end and routing are undocumented.

parts.shapeNote: largest square OIS module, middle of the column

tools.ko: 열풍기, 흡착 손잡이, 오프닝 툴 (분리할 때만)
tools.en: heat, suction handle, iFlex (only if separating)

cautions.ko: 디스플레이는 접착으로 붙은 깨지기 쉬운 부품이에요. 서비스용 부품은 배터리가 미리 붙어서 와요.
cautions.en: Display is a fragile, adhesive-bonded unit; the service part ships with the battery pre-installed

tools.ko: 당김 탭 (잘 안 떨어지면 이소프로필 알코올)
tools.en: pull tab; isopropyl alcohol if it resists

cautions.en: Never use metal tools on the battery

cautions.ko: USB-C 포트를 비스듬히 홈에 먼저 끼운 다음, 보드를 평평하게 눌러요.
cautions.en: Seat the USB-C port into its recess at an angle, then press the board flat.

cautions.ko: 카메라 기판을 카메라 몸체에서 떼지 마세요.
cautions.en: Do not separate camera PCB from its housing

cautions.ko: 초광각 카메라는 핀 두 개에 걸어요. 45도로 기울여 넣어요.
cautions.en: Ultrawide hooks onto two pegs; insert at 45 degrees

cautions.ko: 전면 카메라와 mmWave 케이블을 보드 위로 지나가게 한 뒤 연결해요.
cautions.en: Route front camera and mmWave cables over the board, then connect them

steps.title_en: Display cable and two interconnect cables

cautions.ko: 커넥터는 부품이 없는 평평한 곳만 눌러요.
cautions.en: Press connectors only on flat areas without components

cautions.ko: 나사를 조이기 전에 수화부 스피커를 먼저 연결해요.
배터리는 내부 케이블을 모두 연결한 다음 마지막에 연결해요.
cautions.en: Battery is connected after all internal cables (it is the first thing disconnected after the coil)

cautions.ko: 스피커 테두리를 돌아가며 눌러 프레임에 딸깍 고정한 뒤 나사 13개를 조이고, 코일 커넥터를 꽂아요.
cautions.en: Work round the speaker's rim until it snaps into the frame, then drive the 13 screws and plug in the coil.

cautions.ko: 덮기 전에 동작을 확인해요. 접착제를 새로 잘 붙이지 않으면 방수 성능(IP68)이 사라져요.
cautions.en: Test the phone before sealing; IP68 is lost unless the adhesive is reapplied well

limitations.ko: 내부 부품의 치수와 위치는 공개된 수치가 없어 외형 치수와 배터리 크기에 맞춰 추정했어요.
limitations.en: No internal dimensions are published; inner positions and sizes are estimated against the outer size and the battery.

limitations.ko: 보조 보드 나사 수는 자료마다 달라요(2개/3개). 보조 보드만 다루는 iFixit 가이드(3개)를 따랐어요.
limitations.en: Sources disagree on the daughterboard screws (2 vs 3); the dedicated iFixit daughterboard guide (3) is followed.

limitations.ko: 진동 모터 위치, 상단 안테나의 이름, mmWave 케이블의 다른 끝은 자료가 없어 추정했어요.
limitations.en: The vibration motor position, the top antenna and the far end of the mmWave cable are not documented and are estimated.

limitations.ko: 스피커 모듈이 보조 보드 위로 이어지는 부분(스피커 날개)은 나사 배치에서 추론한 가설이에요.
limitations.en: The loudspeaker "wing" across the sub board is a hypothesis drawn from its screw layout.

limitations.ko: mmWave 안테나·브래킷은 mmWave 모델(예: SM-S921U)에만 있어요.
limitations.en: The mmWave antenna and bracket exist only on mmWave models (e.g. SM-S921U).

limitations.ko: 케이블 경로, 나사 위치, 차폐 캔 배치는 사진 비례로 그린 그림이에요.
limitations.en: Cable routes, screw positions and shield-can layout are drawn from photo proportions.
